result:
I replaced the `forceCreate` in `PostController.store` with `Post.create(data, { set: { authorId: author.id } })`. The audit's mass-assignment warning on `store` is gone. `authorId` still comes from the session, and `data` now holds only `title`, `excerpt` and `body`, so it passes the fillable check. `bun run typecheck` passes and the two tests still pass.

`bunx guren audit` still reports 1 failure (26 passed, 1 warning): a high-severity advisory in the `source-map-js` dependency. The `katex` advisory above it is also in the tail of the output, so there may be more than one. I didn't change any dependencies and the failure isn't in the app code. It needs a dependency upgrade or an ignore entry with a reason in `config/audit.ts`, so I've left it for you to decide.
